label: Market Close
headline: S&P +1.31%, SOX +5.66%, Nasdaq 100 +2.28%, Brent $92.76, Nvidia -8% after hours
stance: Semis and AI infrastructure led a broad rebound with Treasuries closed. Nasdaq 100 futures gave back 1% by ~6pm ET on the Nvidia report.

scorecard.call: Midday: S&P +1.18% at 11:34, semis lead, the Dow did not join.
scorecard.actual: S&P closed +1.31%, SOX +5.66%. Dow joined late, +0.49% at the close.

scorecard.call: Midday: Brent $94.00, +2.7% at 11:24 on a Hormuz mine strike.
scorecard.actual: Brent settled $92.76, +1.4%. Half the midday gain was gone by the settle.

scorecard.call: Morning: EIA crude inventories today; industry data showed a 9.8mb draw.
scorecard.actual: EIA slipped to Thursday for the holiday. Industry data showed a 9.0mb build, not a draw.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Treasuries closed for Veterans Day. Futures price about 90% odds of a 25bp December hike.
Brent +1.4% at the settle after Iran said enriched nuclear material will not leave the country.
Spot gold -1.1%, back under $4,000 for the session.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Every SOX member closed higher. Nasdaq 100 traded up more than 3% intraday, erasing its post-midterm losses.
Memory, optical and neocloud names led. Three megacaps closed lower.
After hours: Nasdaq 100 futures -1%, S&P futures -0.4%, Dow futures flat (~6pm ET).

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: Spread marks still run to Monday's close. No bond trading today to update them.

items.head: Nvidia -8% after hours on report board may oust CEO
items.body: Board could meet as soon as tonight, per reports. Shares -8.4% at 6pm ET, after +2.9% in the session.

items.head: Digi International -11.7% after hours on soft guide
items.body: Q4 EPS $0.78 vs $0.76 est; revenue $143.3m, +25%. Q1 revenue guide $140-144m. Shares -11.7% (~5:30pm ET).

items.head: EZCORP up as much as 11% after hours on beat
items.body: Q4 EPS $0.43 vs $0.42 est; revenue $447.1m vs $427.2m est. Pawn loans +31%. Shares up as much as 11% (~5pm ET).

items.head: EnerSys -1.7% after hours on revenue miss
items.body: Revenue $949.9m vs $972.4m est. Q3 revenue guide midpoint $955m, below consensus. Shares -1.7% (~5pm ET).

watch.head: Jobless claims, Nov 12 8:30
watch.body: Treasuries reopen Thursday. First labor print since the 0.3% core CPI.

watch.head: EIA crude inventories, Thursday
watch.body: Delayed a day by the holiday. The official number tests the industry build.

watch.head: Cisco, Applied Materials after the close Thursday
watch.body: First AI-capex reads after today's semis rally. Cerebras and QXO also report.

watch.head: Nvidia board decision
watch.body: Any decision tonight hits Thursday's open. AMD +3.8% after hours on the report (~6pm ET).
